stories.title: Muon g-2 experiment places new constraints on a forbidden property of muons
stories.desc: A year after its final muon magnetic anomaly announcement, the Muon g-2 collaboration reports a new measurement of a different property of the muon: its electric dipole moment. The work is published on the arXiv preprint server.
